annotations.title: Small Area Fair Market Rent for a ZIP code

description: HUD FY 2027 Small Area Fair Market Rents (ZIP-level, effective Oct 1, 2026) for one ZIP code, studio to 4-bedroom, with the HUD FMR area. A ZIP that crosses areas returns one row per area. Small Area FMRs set voucher payment standards in the 65 mandatory metros and are optional elsewhere.
